summary: RADCOM LTD, an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting a September 9, 2026 press release announcing that Vietnam Posts and Telecommunications Group (VNPT), a state-owned Tier-1 carrier with over 30 million subscribers, selected RADCOM for AI-native, cloud-native service assurance across its roaming network, displacing the incumbent vendor after a competitive RFP. No financial terms, price per share, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed; the 6-K merely incorporates the release by reference into existing Form S-8 registration statements. This is an ordinary commercial customer win, not a special situation.
